decisions.reason: The source uses generic 赛马娘, which must use the project-standard Mã Nương rather than Uma Musume; the date and ticket meaning are preserved.
decisions.terminology_basis: common.world.umamusume requires Mã Nương for generic 赛马娘 and reserves Umamusume for the franchise title.
